fields.topic: Integer geometry and actual demand inputs
fields.finding: The 041 cases have 750 members, 252 joints and 500 cells, with actual arc lengths and 18000 correlated segment force/moment pairs per design. This replaces the noninteger 022d geometry only for the new cases.
fields.remaining: The input FE equilibrium and the fixed-gyration force transfer are inherited, not independently solved here. The old 433-member analysis remains bookkeeping rather than a constructed mesh.
